description: Advisory quality thresholds for Social Explorer CI, retuned from recent `Tests` workflow runs (test.yml) by scripts/auto-qa-tuner.mjs. Nothing in CI reads these values automatically: they are suggestions a human wires into test.yml. The tuner only ever edits this file, and only through a bot-opened pull request that a human merges. It never pushes to main.

bounds.rule: Each parameter has a baseline (authored by a human), hard min and max bounds, and maxStep (the largest change per run). `loosen` says which direction makes the gate weaker. The bound on the loosen side is the documented limit: the tuner can never move a value past it, however bad the data looks. The tuner only writes `value` and `history`; it never edits baseline, min, max or maxStep, so widening a bound is always a human edit in a reviewed PR. `--check` fails if a value is outside its bounds.
bounds.looseningIsBoundedBy: min or max on the loosen side, plus maxStep per run

parameters.description: Suggested timeout-minutes for the Unit Tests (Vitest) job in test.yml (today it has none, so the 360 minute default applies). Measured: about 1.6 minutes per run on 2026-11-12. Target is twice the observed p95 job duration.
Suggested wall-clock budget for the `Run unit tests` step (Vitest with coverage). Measured: about 76 seconds on 2026-11-12. Target is three times the observed p95 duration of that step.

How many automatic re-runs of the unit tests are tolerated before a failure counts. 0 unless at least 10 percent of recent successful runs needed a manual re-run (run_attempt above 1). The maximum is 1: more than one retry hides real failures.

Suggested minimum pass rate for the Tests workflow on main over the window, below which the nightly report should be treated as unhealthy. Target is the observed pass rate minus 5 points. Cannot fall below 80.
